summary.en-US: Organize electronics parts into projects, with variants, prices and cart capture.

description.en-US: Save electronics parts from product pages into projects or a Miscellaneous list. Keep selected model and variant names, product links, unit prices, quantities and purchase status together. MakerBazar pages have a floating save button, and its cart page supports saving all cart items to one project. The project hub shows planned spending, purchased parts value and total saved parts value separately by currency. Includes local JSON backup import/export and a dark appearance. Data stays in your browser profile. No analytics, accounts or developer-operated backend. Automatic site access is limited to makerbazar.in; other stores require a toolbar click. Shipping and checkout-only adjustments are not estimated. Restore a project to MakerBazar by replacing its cart with Planned parts after a preview. A separate Clear Cart button clears immediately without confirmation.

version.approval_notes: Runtime code is readable vanilla JS with no runtime dependencies or remote scripts. Source and build instructions are included in the uploaded source ZIP. Run npm ci then npm run build; dist/firefox-release is the submitted Firefox 140+ build. The package also produces a separate compatibility build for older local Mercury testing; that is not submitted. Product capture is user initiated; a content script on makerbazar.in provides the floating button. Save Cart only reads the store cart. New user-triggered cart actions: Restore Project previews exact Planned variants/quantities, requires confirmation, backs up existing cart lines locally and replaces the cart via Shopify Ajax endpoints; it attempts rollback on failure. Clear Cart on MakerBazar cart pages clears immediately without confirmation, as labeled. No purchases or checkout are submitted. No data is sent to the developer. Test a product page via the toolbar, or a MakerBazar product/cart via the floating button; choose a project or leave the new project name blank for Miscellaneous. Backup import replaces local library data after confirmation.
